name: baseUrl
label: Freero address
help: Leave it as https://freero.app, or give your own Freero server’s address (https).

name: clientId
label: OAuth app client ID (your own Freero server only)
help: On your Freero: Settings → Your OAuth apps → register an app with Confidential app on and the redirect URI https://www.make.com/oauth/cb/app.

name: clientSecret
label: OAuth app client secret (your own Freero server only)
